initial_cwd.description: Sets the initial working directory inside the guest rootfs. Corresponds to -w/--pwd/--cwd.

verbose_level.description: Sets the debug information level. Higher integer = more verbose. Negative = quieter. Corresponds to -v/--verbose.

fake_root.description: Makes the current user appear as root (uid=0, gid=0). Corresponds to -0/--root-id.

kernel_release.description: Makes the current kernel appear as the specified release string. Corresponds to -k/--kernel-release.

change_id.description: Makes the current user and group appear as the specified uid:gid string. Corresponds to -i/--change-id.

qemu_command.description: Specifies the QEMU user-mode command to use for cross-architecture guest programs. Corresponds to -q/--qemu.

mounts.description: List of mount/bind strings in the format 'host_path:guest_path' or 'host_path:guest_path!' to overlay host files/directories. Corresponds to -b/--bind/-m/--mount.

rootfs_path.description: The path to the guest root file-system. Corresponds to -r/--rootfs.

use_recommended_binds.description: If true, uses the -R alias behavior (rootfs + standard recommended binds). Ignores custom mounts list.

use_safe_install_binds.description: If true, uses the -S alias behavior (fake root + rootfs + safe minimal binds). Ignores custom mounts list.

command.description: The command to execute inside the proot environment.
